title: John 2:13-22
subtitle: Dedication of the Lateran Basilica, Feast · Ez 47:1-2, 8-9, 12; 1 Cor 3:9c-11, 16-17; Jn 2:13-22
text: Today the whole Church keeps the anniversary of the Lateran Basilica, the Pope's cathedral and the mother and head of all churches. Jesus cleanses the Temple and then points beyond it: he was speaking of the temple of his body. By baptism we are living stones in that temple, so keep it clean and make a visit to the Blessed Sacrament today.
imageAlt: A sunlit Roman scene with peasants in colorful dress standing on a grassy rise beside ruined brick arches, while a large crowd gathers before the columned facade of the Basilica of St. John Lateran topped by statues.
